newsitem.title: UK: New Indosuez fixed income fund focuses on Russia.
newsitem.headline: New Indosuez fixed income fund focuses on Russia.

text.p: Indosuez Capital said on Thursday it was setting up a new fund to invest in fixed income instruments in eastern Europe, with an emphasis initially on Russia.

"The Fund will be invested in Eastern European fixed income products, initially concentrating on Russian fixed income products and will provide investors with access to the high yield fixed income investments of the eastern European market," Indosuez said in a statement released in London.

"The fund will invest in U.S. dollar and local currency denominated eastern European securities in order to provide investors with higher total returns than straight investments in offshore securities with similar characteristics," it added.

The Indosuez Eastern Europe Fixed Income Fund, Ltd is an open-end vehicle established in the British Virgin Islands. It will be launched on February 4 and investments will be managed by Indosuez Asset Management Emerging Markets SA.
Indosuez has global assets under management of $100 billion, including over $3 billion in emerging market portfolios, it said.

The fund's investment policy will allow it to take short or long positions in any eastern European fixed income products, to trade derivatives or securities issued by any eastern European issuer, and trade in currency and interest rate derivatives of any eastern European country, the statement said.
However it will not invest more than 50 percent of its unhedged assets in instruments denominated in currencies other than U.S. dollars or roubles.
"Particular emphasis will be given to local currency investments which are not easily and immediately accessible to foreign investors," it added.
The investment manager aims to overcome or minimise entry and exit costs and to explore risk arbitrage opportunities through hedged or open positions, the statement said.
It will also offer limited voting shares.
The initial subscription price is $100 per share and the minimum investment amount is $100,000.
Fees are 2.0 percent of the fund's net asset value, payable quarterly. The performance fee is 20 percent of the excess investment profits on any shares.
